text:
Tess Moreno: Partner hardware SI asked what compliance artifacts we can link on the marketplace listing for their gateway device. They specifically called out SOC excerpt, firmware attestation note, and pentest summary. Timeline: partner requests materials for partner review by Fri to hit next Tue announce.

Liam O'Connor: Need to be careful with firmware attestation wording. Do not claim cryptographic signing details; instead say: "Partner provides firmware attestation statement; firmware signing and integrity controls are maintained by partner. Detailed evidence available under NDA." Also redact any firmware hashes from public docs.

Arjun Patel: Security: pentest summary ok as 3-line exec summary + CVSS counts. For firmware, publish only the attestation statement (one paragraph) and sanitized supply-chain diagram. No build logs or signing keys.

Kara Nguyen: Legal: prefer SOC phrasing: "Partner maintains SOC2 Type II attestation related to security; full reports shared under NDA." Add embargo: "Embargo until 2024-08-06 08:00 PT." Partner has an NDA but asked for 48h review after we send draft.

deploy-bot: Uploaded: partnerHW_supplychain_public_v1.pdf (owner: Tess Moreno)

Tess Moreno: Owners: SOC excerpt - Kara; Firmware attestation blurb - Liam; Pen-test summary - Arjun. I'll assemble the public bundle, create redacted PDFs, and request presigns (7d). Please confirm by Thu EOD so I can hand to partner Fri AM.

Liam O'Connor: Confirmed. I'll draft the firmware attestation blurb and avoid operational details about keys or hashes.

Arjun Patel: I'll prepare the pentest blurb Thu AM and post redaction notes.

Kara Nguyen: I'll run legal checklist once drafts are up and flag any required language changes.

Tess Moreno: Great—if we hit Thu EOD approvals we should be good for the partner review window. DM me for follow-ups.
